# Templates

Copy a template, rename it, and replace every bracketed line.

| Template | For |
|---|---|
| [Runbook](runbook.md) | `docs/runbooks/` |
| [Discovery Record](discovery-record.md) | `docs/discovery/` |
| [Design Doc](design-doc.md) | `docs/design/` |

ADRs use the template in [the ADR folder](../adr/README.md).
